name: rccf-website
description: Website for the Robotics Club of Central Florida

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm run db:up && npm --prefix server run migrate && npm --prefix server run generate && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix server run format && npm --prefix web run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix server run format:check && npm --prefix web run format:check
